designThesis: 한 명의 전투원이 두 개의 잔상과 박자를 겹쳐 전선을 찢고 지나간다.

identity.personality: 전술 드론과 혼잣말처럼 대화하며 리듬이 깨지는 것을 싫어한다.
identity.flavor: 한 번의 빈틈에 두 개의 궤적을 겹쳐 넣는다.
identity.motif: 쌍의 리듬, 바람의 잔상, 정확한 세 번째 박자

assetSpec.camera: flat orthographic side view facing east
assetSpec.debugOverlay: show anchor, visible bounds, footprint, and effect envelope

silhouette.primaryRead: asymmetric short hair, low forward lean, two separated blade arcs
mustReadAtRuntime: one body with two autonomous-looking afterimage drones
split dual blades, never a single sword silhouette
short asymmetric jacket and one raised shoulder guard
coat tails and blade trails flowing backward to communicate air
mustAvoid: floating effects disconnected from the hands

weapon.name: 분절 쌍도
weapon.read: two short segmented blades with separate cyan and violet edge glints

idle.purpose: breathing, hand correction, and subtle drone orbit

walk.purpose: low forward run with contact, passing, and recovery micro-poses

aim.purpose: blade-ready hold with small air current

hit.purpose: impact compression, recoil, blade correction, and return to guard

death.purpose: afterimages collapse first, knees fail, body falls, then grounded stillness

generation.identityReference: ungoo-benchmark/moa-ungoo-benchmark-master-v1.png; 256x253, 63-color transparent production-style master; v21 reuses only the high-density authored frame sources and retains Moa identity while using Ungoo rifleman as pixel-production benchmark only
generation.productionStyleBenchmark: Starline Ungoo rifleman: compact 256x253 silhouette, restricted palette, hard pixel clusters, stable side-view frame-to-frame motion; no character, weapon, pose, or pixel reuse
generation.pixelPolish: native nearest-pixel raster pass with one shared 128-color palette across all clips; preserve high-density source frames, pre-align action feet, keep motion-stable walk sources, recolor detached neutral bottom lines, and review both 1x and 4x
generation.frameMode: one complete transparent frame per authored pose, then shared-motion normalize
promptConstraints: no white matte, gray/black backdrop, checkerboard, or glow fringe
same face, hair, costume, weapon geometry, camera, scale, and palette
hard native pixel clusters, no anti-aliasing, no painterly gradients
compact silhouette with deliberate empty transparent margins; animate by small controlled deltas around this master
keep head and torso identity fixed while allowing coat, blades, and afterimages to move
generation.negativePrompt: front view, perspective, single sword, shield, rifle, cape, scenery, labels, text, watermark, extra limbs, duplicated body, white background, gray background, checkerboard, glow halo, anti-aliasing, blur

manualChecks: read silhouette at 1x and 4x nearest preview
confirm the third attack beat is visibly stronger
confirm afterimages never read as extra playable bodies
confirm blade trails are attached to blade motion
run Godot battlefield screenshot with anchor/debug overlay
